items.title: Second-life batteries for grid services signal pilot scaling but standards gaps remain
items.lede: Indications from pilot programs suggest increasing use of second-life EV batteries for frequency response and peak shaving, but standards and end-of-life frameworks may lag, creating uncertainty for scaling.
